core.summary: A detached house set in approx. 2.1 acres on the North Downs, with an indoor swimming pool, triple garage and three reception rooms. Within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt.
core.listing:
A detached house built in 1987, set in approx. 2.1 acres on Pilgrims Way. The property includes an indoor swimming pool, triple garage and oil-fired central heating.

The accommodation comprises four bedrooms, three bathrooms and three reception rooms. The plot extends to approx. 2.1 acres and includes a driveway and triple garage.

The property lies within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: Driveway. Building safety: None known. Restrictions: within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Rights & easements: None known. Flooding: None known. Coastal erosion: None known. Planning: None known. Accessibility: None known. Coalfield / mining: None known.
